title: Bistek Filipino-Style Stir-Fry
description: A vegetarian twist on the classic Filipino dish, bistek, featuring tender beef substitute and a sweet soy sauce marinade.
instructions: Cut the bistek into thin strips.
In a bowl, combine soy sauce, patis, and black pepper.
Add the bistek to the marinade and mix well.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add the bistek.
Cook until the bistek is browned and crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped celery to the pan and cook until tender.
